numericPrecisionFollowup.testFix: Updated only stale assertions; added checks for line-height 1.25→1.35→1.25, scale 1.2→1.3, and z-index -12→-11 using the declared keyboard increments. Line-height check undoes its setup and restores the inherited baseline before the Save/Publish lifecycle.
numericPrecisionFollowup.failedRuns: The first two post-change lifecycle runs surfaced stale line-height, then scale assertions. They were corrected without weakening application validation; the complete test then passed.
